purpose: External marketplace analytics plus connected-cabinet analytical read models, MPSTATS repricer/advertising views and optional creative services. It is not the canonical internal identity registry and is not the default marketplace write executor.

wb_market_analytics.meaning: External/public Wildberries market, niche, seller, brand, SKU and search analytics.
wb_market_analytics.default_use: primary MPSTATS source for competitor/niche/market research
canonical_for: MPSTATS analytical view of WB external market
wb_market_analytics.freshness: Most dated reports default through yesterday; wb_check_rates is a live snapshot.

ozon_market_analytics.meaning: External/public Ozon market, category, seller, brand and SKU analytics.
ozon_market_analytics.default_use: primary MPSTATS source for Ozon competitor/niche research
canonical_for: MPSTATS analytical view of Ozon external market
ozon_market_analytics.freshness: Most dated reports default through yesterday.

ym_market_analytics.meaning: External/public Yandex Market category, brand, seller and item analytics.
ym_market_analytics.default_use: primary MPSTATS source for YM market research
canonical_for: MPSTATS analytical view of Yandex Market
ym_market_analytics.freshness: Most dated reports default through yesterday.

wb_cabinet.meaning: Analytical view of the user's connected Wildberries cabinet(s) through MPSTATS LK tools.
wb_cabinet.default_use: own-business analytics, funnel, reports, stock distribution, card-level analysis
wb_cabinet.freshness: Provider-defined; verify dates/period and cabinet scope.

ozon_cabinet.meaning: Analytical view of the user's connected Ozon cabinet(s) through MPSTATS.
ozon_cabinet.default_use: own Ozon economics, products, funnel and daily dynamics
ozon_cabinet.freshness: Provider-defined; verify dates and cabinet scope.

wb_advertising.meaning: Wildberries advertising and bidder analytics for connected cabinets.
wb_advertising.default_use: read-only analysis of spend, DRR, campaigns, clusters, events and product-level ad performance
not_canonical_for: ad execution unless a separately approved write tool exists

repricer.meaning: MPSTATS repricer configuration, products, competitors, regions and price-change history.

own_products.meaning: Current prices/status/history for products under MPSTATS-connected marketplace tokens.
own_products.default_use: read-only MPSTATS view of connected own products

photo_editor.meaning: MPSTATS creative image-processing and generation service.

identifier_rules.marketplace_sku: Company-wide semantic key for a marketplace card only when marketplace and store context are known.
identifier_rules.wb_sku_nmid: Treat as WB marketplace_sku candidate only in marketplace=wb context; resolve store via internal product catalog.
identifier_rules.ozon_sku: Treat as Ozon marketplace-scoped SKU; never as internal_article.
identifier_rules.internal_article: Never infer from MPSTATS display names or product labels; resolve through internal product_catalog.
identifier_rules.category_path: MPSTATS marketplace taxonomy path, not an internal company category id.
identifier_rules.warning: MPSTATS-local ids are not interchangeable with marketplace SKU, internal article or direct marketplace cabinet identifiers.

global_guardrails: Never use wb_shelves_project automatically; it changes MPSTATS account state.
Do not use Photo Editor tools unless the user explicitly asks for image generation/editing.
Do not use pe_run by default; prefer typed Photo Editor tools.
Do not use lk_wb_request while a typed lk_wb_* tool covers the task.
Before bulk/paginated MPSTATS work, check account_limits and minimize calls.
External WB/Ozon/YM analytics generally do not include today; default end date is yesterday unless the tool explicitly states live behavior.
For any operational action decision, separate analysis evidence from execution evidence and verify through the designated executor/direct source.
